articles.title: Tens of thousands protest against far-right AfD party in Germany
articles.description: About 150,000 demonstrators took to the streets in around 20 cities across Germany on Saturday against the far-right AfD, after the party scored a crushing victory in a state election last week. The Alternative for Germany (AfD) topped the vote in the eastern region of Saxony-Anhalt, and is now seeking to form the first extreme-right state government in Germany since World War II.

articles.title: BRICS: What is in the joint statement from the 11 members?
articles.description: Members of the 11-nation BRICS group including China, Russia, Iran and India called for calm in the Middle East at a summit in New Delhi on Saturday, overcoming earlier divisions to issue a joint statement. Chinese President Xi Jinping, who joined Russian, Iranian, Indian and other leaders in India's capital, told the summit that the Middle East war "does not serve the common interests of the international community". France 24's Andrew Hilliar tells us more.

articles.title: Russia's Putin arrives in India as BRICS leaders begin talks
articles.description: President Putin arrived as talks among leaders of the BRICS diplomatic bloc began on Friday in India, amid global geopolitical turmoil, including the war in Ukraine and the conflict in the Middle East.

articles.title: Danish WWII drama wins Golden Lion at Venice Film Festival
articles.description: A Danish WWII drama about a woman trying to hide a wartime relationship with a Nazi was awared top prize on Saturday at The Venice Film Festival, while Gaza documentary NAZA snagged the special jury prize. "Unknown Woman" had been a major talking point of the festival due to its subject matter, which has rarely been explored in film, and because director May el-Toukhy was almost alone as a woman director in the event.

articles.title: Jewish ‘supercop’ runs on Arab ticket in Israeli polls – and sparks a storm
articles.description: Former Israeli police officer Yoav Segalovitz's decision to run as the No. 2 candidate on the Arab Raam party ticket in the October 2026 elections marks a paradigm change in Israeli politics. Far-right politicians have slammed the move, but it could pave the way for an Arab party to join a coalition opposing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his allies.

articles.title: "Un instrument stratégique de pression supplémentaire" : pourquoi les rebelles houthis servent les intérêts de l'Iran en s'emparant du détroit de Bab el-Mandeb
articles.description: La prise de ce passage stratégique par les alliés de Téhéran pourrait ouvrir un nouveau front et "renchérir le coût de la confrontation avec les Etats-Unis", selon un expert.

articles.description: "Nous condamnons fermement ces attaques ennemies insidieuses", a réagi le groupe sidérurgique. En plus des frappes mortelles, d'autres ont blessé 35 personnes dans la ville portuaire d'Odessa.

articles.title: BRICS leaders meet in India as wars and US tensions test the bloc

Our correspondent Navodita Kumari tells us more.

articles.title: Houthis seize key sites around Bab el-Mandeb as Saudi oil exports face disruption
articles.description: Saudi Arabia has stopped transferring oil through a major pipeline after it was attacked by drones. Meanwhile, Houthi forces have taken control of a strategic port and island in Bab el-Mandeb from Yemeni government forces. Iran, which backs the rebels, says it had nothing to do with the attacks.

articles.title: Trump will meet with Ireland's leaders before heading to his golf club in Doonbeg
articles.description: President Donald Trump arrived Saturday in Dublin, where he'll hold talks with Ireland's president and prime minister, kicking off a weekend visit that's more about a major golf tournament held on a course he owns on the country's Atlantic coast.

articles.title: Yémen : qui sont les Houthis, ce groupe rebelle pro-Iran, qui contrôle désormais un détroit stratégique pour le commerce mondial

articles.title: Trump says unified Ireland ‘would be fantastic' during Dublin trip
articles.description: US President Donald Trump on Saturday said a unified Ireland would be “fantastic" during a weekend visit to a major tournament at his Irish golf course. The two-day trip to Ireland is the latest example of how the US leader blends his official duties with his personal interests.

articles.title: Céline Dion makes historic Paris comeback, six years after last tour

articles.title: « Le maoïsme a pu s’enraciner dans des régions et des moments très divers grâce à sa nature multiforme, contradictoire et malléable »
articles.description: « Mao, l’encombrant héritage » (7/7). Cinquante ans après la mort du Grand Timonier, Julia Lovell, professeure d’histoire et de littérature chinoises à l’université Birkbeck, à Londres, retrace, dans un entretien au « Monde », la diffusion mondiale du maoïsme. Selon elle, cette idéologie a bénéficié d’une contingence historique, l’ère de la décolonisation, qui a fait de Mao la figure de proue de l’anti-impérialisme.
